issue.body:
## What to build

diagnose actual contextual-meaning adjudication and truthful residual accounting from the two exact US2/GB3 occurrences above. Both final articles are faithful under their own blind judgment; the reports impose stronger specialised meanings, the parent accepts them, and the final account falsely declares a defect. Preserve correct rejection/acceptance and author's argument. Local known-defects instruction coexists with report-as-allegation instruction; diagnose their effect, not merely assume wording is causal. No false repair happened in those runs.

Evidence: `docs/evaluation/editorial-362/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/runs/opinion-en_US-r2/` and `opinion-en_GB-r3/`, their source/draft/report captures, parent `trace.jsonl`, `response.txt`, `byte-comparisons.json`, and matching `judges/<run>/captured-output.md`. US2 final report `0011-10ca1b7fd8ca.md`, final draft `0010-bd5699cf5bad.md`; GB3 final report states `0011-406d5826ec00.md`/`0012-34342ce9a92a.md`, final draft `0010-d3eade6d05c1.md`. Reviewed local brief `docs/evaluation/editorial-362/finalisation-2026-10-02/followups/false-known-defect.md`. Exact context source says “Den mäter inte ålder, funktionsförmåga eller digital vana”; draft US2 “The report measures neither age, functional ability, nor digital experience”. The two report-state revisions are not extra comparisons. GB1's contrary recorded contextual reading remains a control, not a universal synonym ruling. Closed #376's last-checked-prose/residual disclosure works here; #379/#387 are different denial cases, #475/#490 Redline accounts. No open duplicate of this Write adjudication is identified.

## Writable surfaces

skills/editorial/write/references/source-check.md and only semantically affected Write SKILL.md/help.md; new issue-owned regression/evaluation directory and records. Shared Library base/delivery are read-only by default; a causal demonstrated shared change requires its own allocation/serialized consumer sweep. No public grammar/frontmatter changes.

## Execution and scope

The user commissioned autonomous repair on 2026-10-03; ordinary technical, fixture and capture choices are delegated. This is separate product repair, not reopening closed #362's completed evidence import. Historical plans/raw judgments/failed outcomes and original source trees remain unchanged. Root assigns independent verification and decides integration/closure; builders use `Refs`, never a closing trailer.

Before #499 passes independently, author only source/brief validation material, criteria and fixture preparation; run no editorial baseline/candidate and change no semantic product. Then freeze a provider-native same-seat plan, perform neutral contrast validation, run a real red-capable seam before causal hypotheses, and use at most one revise arm. Native stochastic semantics cannot honestly promise a two-second deterministic loop; byte/transport checks alone prove no semantic repair. Instrumented acquisitions and uninstrumented observations stay distinct. Exact public invocation, inherited checker seat, complete original source/draft, two-comparison ceiling, final prose freeze, author's stance, source/destination/cleanup and comparison timing remain intact.

Write runtime allocation is only `skills/editorial/write/SKILL.md`, `help.md`, and `references/source-check.md`; edit only a causally demonstrated surface. Library/locale/Proofread resources, protocol/harness and central tests remain read-only to this builder. Any required shared surface is separately allocated and serialized. Generated catalog may be regenerated; issue-owned new evidence/records are writable. A final independent acceptance on eventual integrated runtime must cover all four Write repair concerns (# IDs recorded by follow-up) together. Follow-up issues alone do not finish an established surviving problem.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve both occurrence chains/report states/dispositions; fresh same-seat baseline reproduces or honestly records nonreproduction.
- [ ] At least two native repetitions of each US2/GB3 exact source scenario plus validated supported-error and successful-rejection contrasts; component replays distinguish false contextual sense from true measurement change. Article/report/account judged separately by two neutral readers. No term answer key.
- [ ] Candidate rejects unsupported stronger-reading allegation with exact source/draft evidence, retains supported findings and genuinely unresolved support, and final account truthfully distinguishes settled defect from reported allegation; exact compared prose and two-comparison cap pass.
- [ ] Full evidence, counts, time/cost/limits, source/output/cleanup and remaining misses retained; bounded ship rule and four CONTRIBUTING gates pass, catalog current.

Blocked by: #499 — independently accepted capture and complete-contract preparation before editorial validation/runs.
